content: Vietnam Decree 13/2023/ND-CP requires explicit, informed, affirmative consent before processing personal data, with heightened technical/physical safeguards (encryption, access control) for sensitive categories including biometric and location data. Vietnam's new Personal Data Protection Law (effective Jan 1 2026) adds employment-specific rules requiring explicit consent for employee monitoring. Practical implication: attendance photos + GPS coordinates are sensitive personal data under Vietnamese law — need explicit consent capture, data minimization, and access restricted to same-company authorized roles.
